selection: Purposive, project-authored white-box cases; known defects plus boundary variants. No held-out or independent validation claim.
threat_model: Attacker may supply a canonical envelope or an enforcement request and reuse a token. Attacker may not change loaded policy, benchmark expectations, or signing keys. All effects are simulated.
positive_preconditions: Positive cases assume evidence and approval labels were supplied by trusted upstream sources. This harness does not authenticate them. Negative provenance/approval cases explicitly remove that assumption while exercising the same raw-envelope boundary.
scope: 33 unsafe requests plus 8 eligible controls from the 59-case benchmark. The other 18 cases remain in the source results.
observations_note: Recorded benchmark observations, not raw token or receipt objects. Token strings were not retained. Requests are complete, with JSON types preserved; formatting is newly generated and is not an original wire capture.
canonical_input_hash: SHA-256 of json.dumps(request, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False).encode().
